D4.z_definition: z_k = (adapted_k - m_k(age,sex)) / sigma_k(age,sex); m_k = X·beta_mean, sigma_k = exp(0.5·X·beta_logvar) floored at 0.25; X=[1,(age-50)/10,((age-50)/10)^2,sex,sex·(age-50)/10]; sex 1=female
D4.q_definition: q = C · z  (z restricted to this score's phases, in phase_order)
D4.mu_q_convention: uncentered Mahalanobis (mu_q=0), matches frozen development compute_D; verified reproduces dev.D_raw to <1e-4
D4.per_1SD_meaning: HR per +1 SD of D_std == +0.757840 units of raw D

A_definitions.A_four_phase_for_primary: A_std (4-phase A4) is used in the PRIMARY M1/M2/M3. Each 3-phase sensitivity uses its OWN matching 3-phase A (A3_noAV / A3_dropP), NOT the 4-phase A.
A_definitions.DEVIATION_NOTE: In the original development scores, A_std_noAV was standardized on the DEVELOPMENT partition (center 0.3746, scale 1.3932). RC1 standardizes ALL A/D scores from the outcome-blind CALIBRATION partition for consistency (A3_noAV center 0.000111, scale 1.329517). This changes ONLY the noAV sensitivity's A standardization; the primary D4/M2 is unaffected; the mortality association is refit fresh at reveal so no frozen coefficient is invalidated.

cox_models.M5: M2 with D_std as restricted cubic spline (3 knots at 10/50/90th pct of D_std on CALIBRATION partition)
cox_models.primary_estimand: HR per +1 SD of D_std in M2; LRT M2 vs M1 (1 df); alpha=0.05 two-sided; success = p<0.05 AND HR>1
cox_models.nn_predicted_age: published Lima et al. CODE-15 age-clock prediction (comparator), from exams.csv

missing_data_behavior.rule: complete-case on the model's covariates + (event,timey). A record with ANY NaN across its required phase predictions is dropped (prespecified §10 complete-case).
missing_data_behavior.qc: analysis restricted to qc_ok index exams (frozen analysis population).
missing_data_behavior.one_exam_per_patient: salted-hash tie-break, first per patient (see verifier).

outcome_free_R2_D4_given_M1.interpretation: D4 is nearly orthogonal to M1 covariates (R2~0.009-0.018), so R2=0 in the power calc is a mild optimistic upper bound, not exact.

canonicalization.step2: Drop every top-level key beginning with underscore (the _content_self_sha256 field itself and any _-prefixed metadata).
canonicalization.step3: Serialize the remaining object with json.dumps(obj, sort_keys=True) — Python default separators (', ', ': '), ensure_ascii=True, UTF-8 encode.
canonicalization.step4: sha256 of those UTF-8 bytes = content_self_sha256.
canonicalization.raw_file_sha256: sha256 of the file's raw bytes on disk (indent=2 pretty-printed, UTF-8), as written.
canonicalization.note: content_self is invariant to pretty-print/whitespace/key-order; raw_file pins the exact bytes.

analysis_N.rule: Fitted denominator = qc_ok index exams with ALL FOUR phase predictions present (complete-case per §10). The eligible pool 75,063 is the age_adaptation followup_valid patient count and MUST NOT be used as the fitted denominator.
analysis_N.note: OOS complete-case N is computed at reveal on the same rule; expect <=40,065.
